segments.t: When I saw the first photograph of the microprocessor at the age of 17, you know,
I was reading a magazine on the street and I started crying. Truly, physically, I started crying
on the street. I said, this is going to change the future of mankind. The microprocessor eventually
becomes so powerful, so smart, that it will be smarter than people's brain eventually.
And I predicted maybe 50 years. It's damn right. It's now 50 years. I was 17 years old. I'm 69.
So exactly 50 years, now the microprocessors, the power of the brain in data centers,
these are all happening. And now it's going to go into the brain of the robotics.
